La Paz Shopping Center

The project

La Paz Shopping Center,
Laguna Niguel.

A neighborhood shopping center at La Paz Road and Aliso Creek Road, marketed by Parker & Associates, Inc. Every suite is leased, so the work markets the center itself: drone photography, a redrawn site plan with the current tenants, an eight-page brochure, a center page on the brokerage website and a short film.

Property
Ten-suite shop building · Walgreens and Wild Fork pads
Client
Parker & Associates, Inc.
Scope
Photography, site plan, brochure, website & film
01

Photography

A drone survey of the whole center, with the strongest frames pulled from the 4K footage and relit, plus a stitched overhead of the property.

02

Site plan

Redrawn from the 2018 leasing plan and the overhead, with every suite, both pads, the driveways, the left turn in and the current tenants.

03

Brochure

Eight pages with the site plan, tenant logos, drive times, traffic counts and demographics.

04

Website & film

A center page on digitalre.com with an animated site plan and tenant logos, and a 51-second film.

01 / The website

Center website.

A page for the center on the Parker & Associates, Inc. website, designed around Laguna Niguel’s canyon greenbelts: a looping film of the center, the site plan with every tenant’s logo, drive times, demographics and the leasing contacts.

Visit the center page
digitalre.com / La Paz Shopping Center

02 / Interactive site plan

Interactive site plan.

The plan draws itself as it scrolls into view. Hover or tap a suite to see the tenant, or switch to the aerial to see the same plan over the overhead. Cars on La Paz Road and Aliso Creek Road stop at the signal, and some turn left into the main driveway.

See it on the center page

    Traffic counts: OCTA 2026 Traffic Flow Map (2022 counts). Suite lines follow the 2018 leasing site plan; the plan is not to scale.

    04 / Photography

    Photography
    & retouching.

    Frames pulled from the 4K drone footage, relit to late-afternoon light, with the asphalt resealed, the striping refreshed and window signs removed. Tenant signage, buildings and parking are unchanged. Drag across each photo to compare.

    OriginalRetouched

    Retouched with AI-assisted relighting and cleanup.

    OriginalRetouched

    Walgreens, 27982 La Paz Road.

    OriginalRetouched

    Wild Fork, on the former Carl’s Jr. pad.

    05 / Site plan

    Site plan.

    The 2018 leasing plan was a scanned drawing that still showed Carl’s Jr. on the corner pad, which is now Wild Fork. The new plan is traced from the stitched overhead, with the suite lines taken from the 2018 drawing and the current tenant in each suite.

    OriginalRetouched

    The overhead: eleven frames from a straight-down pass at 113 m, stitched into one image of the property and retouched. Buildings, parked cars and the parking layout are unchanged.

    06 / Film

    Center film.

    A 51-second film of the center. The drone moves are AI-assisted motion from the retouched photographs, with a slow pan across the real overhead.
